purpose: private authored activity pilot; not learner-facing

activities.cueEnglish: Find what Rogelio reads aloud from the manufacturer instructions.
activities.modelFrench: Rogelio lit à voix haute la première étape des instructions du fabricant.
activities.modelEnglish: Rogelio reads step 1 of the manufacturer instructions out loud.

activities.cueEnglish: Without looking, name the spec sheet in French.
Listen and identify the term for minimum overlap.
Type 'Don't do it from memory.' in French.
activities.modelFrench: Ne le faites pas de mémoire.

activities.cueEnglish: Ask what the sheet says about the overlap.
activities.modelFrench: Rogelio : « Que dit la fiche sur le recouvrement ? »
activities.modelEnglish: Rogelio: What does the sheet say about the overlap?

activities.cueEnglish: Write which other roof features Kevin says have their own section.
activities.modelFrench: Kevin : « Elle indique son recouvrement minimal; la cheminée et le manchon du tuyau ont une autre rubrique. »
activities.modelEnglish: Kevin: It says you have to use the sheet's minimum overlap, and that the chimney and the pipe boot have another section.

activities.cueEnglish: Find what Rogelio records before speaking with the homeowner.
activities.modelFrench: Rogelio a photographié les dommages et marqué le bord avec de la peinture.
activities.modelEnglish: Rogelio took photos of the damage and marked the edge with paint.

activities.cueEnglish: Without looking, name the change order in French.
Listen and identify the phrase for extra cost.
Type 'Shall I show you the photos?' in French.
activities.modelEnglish: Shall I show you the photos?

activities.cueEnglish: Tell Mr. Ramírez what the crew found beneath the shingles.
activities.modelFrench: Rogelio : « Monsieur Ramírez, quand nous avons retiré les bardeaux, nous avons trouvé du bois pourri. »
activities.modelEnglish: Rogelio: Mr. Ramírez, when we removed the shingles, we found rotten wood.

activities.cueEnglish: Write what Rogelio says about the written extra cost.
activities.modelFrench: Rogelio : « Cela coûterait plus cher et prendrait un jour de plus; le coût supplémentaire est écrit ici, comme le prévoit le contrat. »
activities.modelEnglish: Rogelio: It would cost more and take an extra day, and the extra cost appears here, in writing, as the contract says.

activities.cueEnglish: Find when the supplier says the factory shipment may reach the warehouse.
activities.modelFrench: Le fournisseur : « L’usine annonce une arrivée à l’entrepôt jeudi, mais ce n’est pas certain. »
activities.modelEnglish: Supplier: The factory says it will arrive at the warehouse on Thursday, but it's not certain.

activities.cueEnglish: Without looking, name the substitute in French.
Listen and identify the French term for invoice.
Type 'When will the rest arrive?' in French.
Ask Kevin for help with the rolls.
activities.modelFrench: Rogelio : « Kevin, peux-tu me donner un coup de main avec ces rouleaux ? »
activities.modelEnglish: Rogelio: Kevin, can you give me a hand with these rolls?

activities.cueEnglish: Write what Rogelio asks the supplier to send before deciding.
activities.modelFrench: Rogelio : « Envoyez-moi la fiche technique; avant de décider, je parlerai au client. »
activities.modelEnglish: Rogelio: Send me the spec sheet, and before deciding I'm going to talk to the customer.
